video.description:
Learn to explain how to share and pick content in SwiftUI: ShareLink, PhotosPicker & Transferable, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
ShareLink - A control that opens the share sheet, so the user can send a link, text or image.
PhotosPicker - A control that lets the user choose photos from their library.
Transferable - A protocol that tells SwiftUI how to convert your type for sharing, copying or loading.

landscape.title: SwiftUI ShareLink, PhotosPicker & Transferable | Day 164
landscape.description:
Explain ShareLink, PhotosPicker & Transferable in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
셰어링크, 포토스피커, 트랜스퍼러블 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

ShareLink - A control that opens the share sheet, so the user can send a link, text or image.
한국어: 셰어링크: 사용자가 링크나 텍스트, 이미지를 보낼 수 있게 공유 시트를 열어 주는 컨트롤

PhotosPicker - A control that lets the user choose photos from their library.
한국어: 포토스피커: 사용자가 사진 보관함에서 사진을 고를 수 있게 해 주는 컨트롤

Transferable - A protocol that tells SwiftUI how to convert your type for sharing, copying or loading.
한국어: 트랜스퍼러블: 공유, 복사, 불러오기를 위해 내 타입을 변환하는 방법을 SwiftUI에 알려 주는 프로토콜

landscape.hook: Can you explain ShareLink, PhotosPicker and Transferable in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want users to share a quote from my app.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a ShareLink. It opens the share sheet for a link, text or image.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That works because String is Transferable already.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is a protocol. It tells SwiftUI how to convert your type for sharing, copying or loading.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So my own type needs Transferable too, before I share it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Without it, the ShareLink cannot accept your type.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Next, the profile screen needs a photo from the library. I heard about PhotosPicker.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, use a PhotosPicker. The user chooses photos, and you do not need a permission prompt.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. Is the `selection` a photo already?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it is only an item. You load the image data from it later.
